headline: Feelings Wheel, from entry to detail
overview:
The Feelings Wheel is an interactive emotion-logging tool embedded in the My Reflections page. Users select from 6 core emotions (Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear, Disgust, Surprise), then drill down into 36+ specific sub-emotions via an expanding SVG wheel.

After selecting a specific emotion, users set an intensity level (1-5) and optionally add notes. The tool tracks check-ins over time with a history panel grouped by date, and integrates with the achievement system.
targetAudience: Anyone wanting to build emotional awareness through regular check-ins — from beginners learning to name emotions to experienced practitioners tracking patterns.

steps.title: Feelings Tab — Landing State
steps.description:
Navigate to the Reflections page and select the **Feelings** tab. The page shows the interactive emotion wheel with 6 color-coded core emotions: **Joy** (amber), **Sadness** (blue), **Anger** (red), **Fear** (purple), **Disgust** (emerald), and **Surprise** (pink). The center reads "How do you feel?" and the right panel shows a target icon with instructions to select an emotion.

The **History** and **Info** toggle buttons appear above the wheel.
steps.screenshotAlt: Feelings Wheel landing page showing the 6-segment emotion wheel with Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear, Disgust, and Surprise

steps.title: Select Primary Emotion — Joy Expanded
steps.description:
Click a primary emotion segment (e.g., **Joy**) and the wheel expands to reveal 6 sub-emotions in the outer ring: **Optimistic**, **Playful**, **Excited**, **Grateful**, **Content**, **Peaceful**. The instruction text updates to "Choose a **specific emotion** from the outer ring."

The expansion animation is smooth and the sub-emotion labels are displayed at angles following the arc of the wheel.
steps.screenshotAlt: Feelings Wheel with Joy segment expanded showing 6 sub-emotions: Optimistic, Playful, Excited, Grateful, Content, Peaceful
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: Select Sub-Emotion — Grateful
steps.description:
Click a specific sub-emotion (e.g., **Grateful**) to open the check-in form. The right panel updates to show:

- **Emotion name** ("Grateful") in the primary emotion's color
- **Category label** ("A form of Joy")
- **Intensity slider** — 5 blocks, defaulting to 3/5
- **Notes textarea** (optional) with placeholder "What's on your mind?"
- **Save Check-in** button

The selected sub-emotion is highlighted on the wheel with a darker shade.
steps.screenshotAlt: Feelings Wheel showing Grateful selected with intensity slider at 3/5, notes field, and Save Check-in button
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: Fill In Details & Save
steps.description:
Adjust the **intensity** by clicking one of the 5 blocks (here set to 4/5) and optionally add **notes** describing what triggered the emotion. Click **Save Check-in** to log the entry.

The intensity blocks fill with the primary emotion's color up to the selected level.
steps.screenshotAlt: Feelings Wheel check-in form filled with Grateful at 4/5 intensity and a note about project progress
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: Achievement Unlocked — Emotional Awareness
steps.description: First-time emotion loggers earn the **Emotional Awareness** achievement — a bronze-tier character milestone worth **+10 points**. The achievement popup features a smiling emoji with star eyes and an "Awesome!" dismiss button.
steps.screenshotAlt: Achievement popup showing Emotional Awareness badge with smiling emoji, +10 points, bronze tier
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: Saved State — Today's Check-ins
steps.description: After saving, the **Today's Check-ins** section appears above the wheel showing a count badge and emotion path ("Joy -> Grateful"). The wheel resets to its initial state, ready for another check-in. The form retains the previous selection for quick re-logging.
steps.screenshotAlt: Feelings Wheel after saving showing Today's Check-ins with Joy to Grateful badge above the wheel
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: Emotion History Panel
steps.description:
Click the **History** button to open a slide-out panel showing all logged emotions grouped by date. Each entry displays:

- **Emotion path** (Joy -> Grateful) color-coded
- **Timestamp** (04:04 AM)
- **Intensity bars** (visual blocks)
- **Notes** in italics

The panel can be dismissed with the X button.
steps.screenshotAlt: Emotion History panel showing logged entry for March 19 with Joy to Grateful, intensity bars, and notes
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

keyFeatures: Interactive SVG wheel with 6 core emotions and 36+ sub-emotions
Expanding animation reveals sub-emotions on primary selection
1-5 intensity scale with visual block indicators
Today's Check-ins counter with emotion path badges
tips: Be specific — choosing a sub-emotion like 'Grateful' is more insightful than just 'Joy'
Use the notes field to record what triggered the emotion for better pattern tracking
Log multiple emotions throughout the day to build a complete emotional picture
Check your History regularly to notice recurring patterns
